scope: Independent public-source research only. No production edits or publishing.
status: Capacity policy confirmed; standard-versus-Live-Liner identity confirmed; same-SKU weight conflicts unresolved.

decisions.eu_mono_braid_mm_anchors_all_eight: APPROVE. Exact FRCV model and numeric SKU match confirmed with official EU and US sources.
decisions.au_extra_mm_triples_5000_6000_8000: APPROVE with AU field-level provenance. Numeric SKUs match and both mono and braid middle anchors exactly match EU.
decisions.au_extra_mm_triples_2500_3000_4000: HOLD. Numeric SKUs differ. AU 2500 mono anchor is 175 m / 0.28 mm, whereas EU/US SKU 1653904 has EU 160 m / 0.28 mm.
decisions.dealer_listing_identity: STANDARD FIERCE V, not Live Liner. Pecheur 401820 uses all eight standard numeric SKUs despite the word Live in its title.
decisions.dealer_ipt_cm: Verified as published standard-model dealer specifications for all eight sizes, corroborated by other EU dealer listings. For 5000/6000/8000, official AU also gives 91/104/112 cm on identical numeric SKUs.
decisions.dealer_weights_1000_to_4000: Dealer-supported standard-model figures; US dealer ounce figures agree after rounding. Do not describe these as manufacturer-verified net weights.
decisions.weights_5000_6000_8000: HOLD an unqualified canonical net-weight assertion. Dealer 524/567/785 g conflicts with official AU 557/606/815 g for identical SKUs. No manufacturer correction or measurement was found.

eu_cached.evidence: tables[0], variants, and product.variants joined by Shopify variant id; contains all eight numeric SKUs, FRCV models, and EU barcodes.

eu_public.evidence: Official standard series comparison table; all eight SKUs confirmed.

us_cached.evidence: Seven product variants (1000 through 6000), each with identical EU/US SKU, model, and barcode. This cache DOES NOT contain an 8000 variant.

us_8000_recovered.evidence: Exact selected variant displays Model #: FRCV8000 and SKU: 1653914, plus mono 310/25 yd/lb and braid 390/65 yd/lb. Retrieved through public web tool during this verification.

au.evidence: tables[0] is the STANDARD table; tables[1] is Live Liner. Dedicated official standard product page separately reproduces all six standard rows and conflicting weights.

pecheur.evidence: HTML line 72 identifies eight standard SKUs; lines 2691-2697 label capacity, retrieve cm/tm, and weight g; following SKU-keyed rows provide all quoted values. Also corroborated by search-indexed page text.
pecheur.separate_live_liner_evidence: Linked as a distinct product in standard page HTML line 3676; no reliance on an unread separate page.

official_eu_live_liner.evidence: Official LL SKUs are 1653916 (2500), 1653917 (4000), 1653919 (6000), 1653921 (8000), distinct from all standard SKUs.

eu_dealer_corroboration.evidence: Search-indexed standard Fierce V listing reproduces all eight quoted weight and cm-retrieve pairs.

eu_dealer_sku_corroboration.evidence: Search-indexed table explicitly associates 1653904/06/08/10/12/14 with 272/326/343/524/567/785 g and 83/89/93/91/104/112 cm.

old_generation_comparison.evidence: Fierce IV dealer table lists 557/606/815 g for 5000/6000/8000. This numerical match does NOT prove that the AU Fierce V page copied old data.

units.au_source_warning: AU headings say m/mm, but cell tokens are diameter_mm/length_m, for example 0.38/185. Reverse into 185 m / 0.38 mm; do not ingest the header order literally.
units.ipt: cm per handle turn; native published inch values are separately identified, not silently substituted for cm-to-inch conversions.

weight_investigation.not_live_liner: AU separate LL table gives 688 g for 6000LL/1653919 and 909 g for 8000LL/1653921. Standard 606/815 g are not those LL values.
weight_investigation.us_8000_additional_conflict: 27.1 oz is about 768.27 g, not 785 g. Do not normalize this to 785 g or call it harmless unit rounding.
weight_investigation.no_root_cause_claim: Evidence does not establish a typo, regional construction change, packaged weight, or stale specification. Those explanations remain unverified.
weight_investigation.resolution_needed: A PENN net-weight correction for exact SKU 1653910/12/14, or an appropriately documented physical measurement, is needed to resolve the conflict.
weight_investigation.shopify_weight_not_net_reel_spec: Raw product.variants[].weight values are 340/390/400/470/490/750/790/1000 for EU sizes 1000/2000/2500/3000/4000/5000/6000/8000. They are not displayed net-reel-weight specs; do not substitute them.

additional_discrepancies: Official AU 8000 braid yd/lb is 390/60, but exact official US 8000 variant gives 390/65. Preserve EU mm capacity; do not import AU lb ratings as an automatic US replacement.
AU 2500 and 4000 recovery is 84 and 94 cm on different numeric SKUs; EU dealer values are 83 and 93 cm. Do not use the AU values to correct US/EU rows.

US dealer native retrieve values are 22/30/33/35/37/36/41/44 inches, while EU dealer cm values are 56/75/83/89/93/91/104/112. Keep source-native values or clearly label calculated unit conversions; rounded published units need not be exact conversions.
The US 6000 dealer listing reports mono 23/20 yd/lb; official US says 230/20. Do not copy the dealer capacity typo.

The web-rendered EU .eu table labels capacity m/kg, but the supplied official UK/EU cached table and variant metadata explicitly label m/mm. Record this labeling inconsistency instead of interpreting decimal diameters as breaking strengths.
limitations: Several dealer pages were accessible through search-indexed text but returned cache-miss errors on direct web open. The supplied Pecheur raw HTML independently verifies its values.
No physical measurements, manufacturer contact, or production data edits were performed.
No claim is made that different dealer sites are independent measurements or independent upstream data feeds.
